I investigated the highest elevation in Alaska, which is the largest U.S. state by land mass. The highest point in the state is Denali (formerly known as Mount McKinley). According to the United States Geological Survey (USGS), the official elevation of Denali is 20,310 feet. This measurement was established in September 2015 and remains the current official figure as of late November 2023.
